description: Compile-only (V1) check for all four Part 6 screen/subfile lessons, merged into one connection since none of them can be CALLed non-interactively anyway (per advisor review: no reason to spend 3 separate connections on batches that only ever compile). D0604A/F0604A (06-04, new screen porting R0408A's CHAIN(TOKUIM)+READ(JUCHUM) logic). D0610A/F0610A (06-10, same screen using INDDS instead of numbered *IN03). D0611A/F0611A (06-11, JUCLST4 load-all order list, references F0604A by name on row-select option 5 - not re-verified here, only that D0611A/F0611A themselves compile). D0611BA/F0611BA (06-11b, SHOHIM add/change/delete maintenance subfile). All are WORKSTN/EXFMT programs - per 04-11's own established hardware finding, an interactive WORKSTN program hangs when CALLed over non-interactive SSH (no real 5250 device to satisfy EXFMT's read), so none are CALLed here; interactive behavior (V3) is left to a learner's real 5250 session. QRPGLESRC/QDDSSRC are assumed to already exist by this point (created by part06-0103-freeform / TXSETUP respectively) but ensureSrcFile is included defensively in case this batch runs first.
